text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The third year's Summer Training Camp has 
begun! While some Umamusume are a bit on 
edge, she remains as calm and easygoing as 
ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sharing lively riddles with her friends, 
she headed toward the training camp lodge.
